fields.name: Trianon Convention Centre
fields.description: A majestic, high-ceilinged ballroom built for large-scale summits, international keynotes and gala dinners. Tiered or theatre-style seating, a full-size stage and a grand foyer for registration and networking make it the natural home for our biggest audiences, with room for up to 500 attendees.

fields.name: Voila Hotel
fields.description: A polished, acoustically insulated hotel setting made for executive strategy days, confidential board meetings and focused panel discussions. Quiet breakout rooms, reliable connectivity and attentive hotel service keep every session on schedule for up to 150 attendees.

fields.name: Caudan Arts Centre
fields.description: An agile, design-led space on the Port Louis waterfront with modular partitions and interactive display areas. Ideal for workshops, product launches and creative brainstorming, it reconfigures easily from one open hall to several breakout rooms for up to 200 attendees.

fields.name: Starter Plan
fields.features:
Dedicated room for exactly 50 attendees
Theatre or classroom seating arranged to your agenda
High-definition projector or screen, podium and microphone kit
Technician on hand to set up and support the AV during your session
4-hour exclusive session
Event coordinator to run your timeline on the day
Catering and recording not included (add them as optional services)

fields.name: Professional Plan
fields.features:
Space for 50 to 200 attendees
Stage, lectern, confidence monitor and wireless microphones
Multi-camera streaming set-up for remote attendees
Registration desk and welcome team for arrivals
Up to 6-hour session with a working lunch break
Event coordinator from setup to close
Recording and branding not included (add them as optional services)

fields.name: Enterprise Plan
fields.features:
Exclusive use of the venue for 50 to 500 attendees, with no other events
Custom stage, lighting and large-format screens planned with you
Full production crew: audio, video and lighting technicians
Formal welcome reception and networking break
Dedicated hospitality team and VIP guest handling
Event coordinator who plans with you beforehand and runs the day
Up to 6 hours on the day of your event

fields.name: Stage Design & Branding
fields.description: Backdrops, stage sets, screen content and signage that carry your brand from the registration desk to the keynote stage, designed and installed by our team so the room looks as considered as the agenda.
fields.highlights:
Custom Backdrops
Premium Signage
Screen Content

fields.name: Live Streaming & Recording
fields.description: Take every session beyond the room with crystal-clear 4K video, live streaming for remote attendees and clean audio capture, followed by edited recordings you can share and keep.

fields.name: Corporate Catering
fields.description: Fresh, generous menus served with an easy rhythm, from morning pastries and coffee to working lunches and afternoon refreshments, so your attendees stay energised from the first session to the last.
fields.highlights:
Working Lunch
Coffee Breaks
Networking Bar
